summary: Unified Register Linkage System - All tests passed. Backend: 11/11 tests passed. Frontend: All UI elements verified. The system correctly implements cross-collection uniqueness for register columns (EM/EB/P1/P2/P3) between exams and tasks.
passed_tests: GET /api/register/availability returns 200 OK
Availability returns period_name, period_active, availability with assigned_to structure
Availability returns all 5 slots: EM, EB, P1, P2, P3
assigned_to includes type/id/title for occupied columns (EM shows exam)
Legacy endpoint GET /api/exams/register-availability still works
POST /api/course/{subject_id}/posts with post_type=task and register_column=P1 creates task correctly
POST /api/course/{subject_id}/posts with register_column=EM returns 400 for tasks
POST /api/course/{subject_id}/posts with register_column=EB returns 400 for tasks
Cross-collection conflict: Create task with P1, then exam with P1 returns 409
Delete task releases the column (P1 becomes available again)
Cleanup test data works correctly
Frontend: Login successful
Frontend: Course detail page loads correctly
Frontend: TAREAS tab clickable and shows task list
Frontend: PremiumTaskModal opens with 'Crear primera tarea' button
Frontend: PremiumTaskModal shows task-register-linkage-block
Frontend: PremiumTaskModal shows task-bimester-badge with 'BIMESTRE I ACTIVO' (read-only)
Frontend: PremiumTaskModal shows ONLY P1/P2/P3 options (no EM/EB)
Frontend: PremiumTaskModal shows 'Disponible' badges for available columns
Frontend: PremiumTaskModal shows 'Sin vinculacion' selected by default
Frontend: EXÁMENES tab clickable and shows exam list
Frontend: ExamModal opens with '+ Nuevo examen' button
Frontend: ExamModal shows register-linkage-block
Frontend: ExamModal shows bimester-badge with 'BIMESTRE I ACTIVO' (read-only)
Frontend: ExamModal shows all 5 options (EM, EB, P1, P2, P3) + 'Sin vinculacion'
Frontend: ExamModal shows EM as 'Ya asignado' (taken by existing exam)
Frontend: ExamModal shows EB, P1, P2, P3 as 'Disponible'
critical_code_review_comments: Backend correctly implements unified availability endpoint at /api/register/availability
Triple verification (exams + tasks + manual grades) working correctly
Cross-collection uniqueness enforced via register_column_assignments collection
Tasks correctly restricted to P1/P2/P3 only (400 error for EM/EB)
Delete cleanup properly releases columns for reuse
Frontend ExamModal correctly shows read-only bimester badge instead of dropdown
Frontend PremiumTaskModal correctly shows only P1/P2/P3 options
Both modals show availability status with 'Disponible' or 'Ya asignado' badges
seed_data_creation: None - used existing course 'Ciencias Naturales' and existing exam 'Examen Mensual - Test Auto Zero' which occupies EM column
context_for_next_testing_agent: Unified register linkage system complete. Key endpoints: GET /api/register/availability (unified), POST /api/course/{subject_id}/posts with register_column for tasks (P1/P2/P3 only), POST /api/course/{subject_id}/exams with register_column for exams (EM/EB/P1/P2/P3). Legacy endpoint /api/exams/register-availability still works. Frontend modals use read-only bimester badge (auto-resolved from active period). Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_unified_register_linkage.py for regression testing.

backend.unified_availability: GET /api/register/availability returns period_name, period_active, availability with assigned_to (type/id/title)
backend.triple_verification: Checks exams + tasks + manual grades for column availability
backend.task_column_restriction: Tasks can only link to P1/P2/P3 (400 for EM/EB)
backend.cross_collection_conflict: Returns 409 when column already assigned by exam or task
backend.delete_cleanup: Deleting task releases column via register_column_assignments cleanup

frontend.exam_modal_all_columns: Shows EM, EB, P1, P2, P3 + 'Sin vinculacion' options
frontend.task_modal_p_columns_only: Shows only P1, P2, P3 + 'Sin vinculacion' (no EM/EB)
frontend.availability_badges: 'Disponible' for available, 'Ya asignado' for occupied columns
